sys_remote_update_set.description: Loan Desk - stands up the IT equipment loan desk as a Global-scope custom application (six stories). Story 1 - Loan Request table (schema foundation): u_loan_request extends task with requester, asset tag, loan status, due date, overdue and notes, LN auto-numbering, plus a Loan Desk application menu with a Loan Requests module. Test: open Loan Desk > Loan Requests, click New, save with a requester and asset tag and expect number LN0001001, loan status defaulting to requested, requester and asset tag mandatory. Story 2 - Approval gatekeeper business rule: a before insert/update rule aborts requested -> returned and aborts approval without a due date, server-side. Test: on a requested loan set loan status to returned and save (error message, record unchanged, also when done via REST or import); set approved with an empty due date (error); then set a due date, save as approved, save as returned (both succeed). Story 3 - Form usability client scripts: notes stay hidden until a requester is chosen; a warning appears when loan status flips to returned while due date is empty. Test: open a new form (Notes hidden), pick a requester (Notes appears), set loan status to returned with an empty due date (warning on due date), fill the due date and change status again (no warning). Story 4 - Overdue loan sweep: a scheduled script execution runs daily at 02:00, sets overdue=true on approved loans past their due date (idempotent, returned and not-yet-due loans untouched) and fires u_loan_request.overdue, which sends the "Loan Overdue Alert" email to the requester naming asset tag and due date. Test: create an approved loan due yesterday, open the job and click Execute Now, confirm overdue is true, run it again (no further change), and check System Mailboxes / Outbox for the email; a returned loan and a loan due tomorrow stay untouched. Story 5 - Roles and ACLs: roles lab_borrower and lab_supervisor; borrower may read and create but not write, delete or approve (write on u_loan_status is supervisor-only); supervisor may read, create, write, delete and approve; users without either role may not read. Test: impersonate a user with each role and one with neither and verify list visibility, New, editing, deleting and whether loan status can be changed to approved. Story 6 - Form and list layout: form sections Identification (number, requester, asset tag), Scheduling (loan status, due date, overdue with overdue read-only) and Remarks (notes); the list shows number, requester, asset tag, loan status, due date, overdue. Test: open a Loan Request and verify the three titled sections and the read-only overdue flag, then open the list and verify the six columns.
sys_remote_update_set.name: Loan Desk

sys_update_xml.name: sys_script_4f3a9b2c8d1e5f6a7b8c9d0e1f2a3b10
sys_update_xml.payload:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sys_script"><sys_script action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><abort_action>false</abort_action><action_delete>false</action_delete><action_insert>true</action_insert><action_query>false</action_query><action_update>true</action_update><active>true</active><add_message>false</add_message><advanced>true</advanced><collection>u_loan_request</collection><condition/><description>Server-side gatekeeper: a loan may not go straight from requested to returned, and approval requires a due date. Runs before insert and update, so it also covers REST and imports.</description><filter_condition/><is_rest>false</is_rest><name>Loan Request approval gatekeeper</name><order>100</order><priority>100</priority><script>(function executeRule(current, previous /*null when async*/) {
	if (current.u_loan_status.changesTo('returned')) {
		var prior = current.isNewRecord() ? 'requested' : previous.u_loan_status.toString();
		if (prior === 'requested') {
			gs.addErrorMessage('A loan request must be approved before it can be returned.');
			current.setAbortAction(true);
			return;
		}
	}
	if (current.u_loan_status.changesTo('approved') && current.u_due_date.nil()) {
		gs.addErrorMessage('A due date is required before a loan request can be approved.');
		current.setAbortAction(true);
	}
})(current, previous);</script><sys_id>4f3a9b2c8d1e5f6a7b8c9d0e1f2a3b10</sys_id><when>before</when></sys_script></record_update>

sys_update_xml.name: sysauto_script_4f3a9b2c8d1e5f6a7b8c9d0e1f2a3b16
sys_update_xml.payload:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sysauto_script"><sysauto_script action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><active>true</active><condition/><conditional>false</conditional><name>Overdue loan sweep</name><run_start/><run_time>1970-01-01 02:00:00</run_time><run_type>daily</run_type><script>(function() {
	var loan = new GlideRecord('u_loan_request');
	loan.addQuery('u_loan_status', 'approved');
	loan.addQuery('u_overdue', false);
	loan.addNotNullQuery('u_due_date');
	loan.addQuery('u_due_date', '<', gs.beginningOfToday());
	loan.query();
	while (loan.next()) {
		loan.setValue('u_overdue', true);
		loan.update();
		gs.eventQueue('u_loan_request.overdue', loan, loan.getValue('u_requester'), loan.getDisplayValue('u_due_date'));
	}
})();</script><sys_id>4f3a9b2c8d1e5f6a7b8c9d0e1f2a3b16</sys_id></sysauto_script></record_update>
